stages.title: Broadcast Prophet
stages.summary: Rex still pirates the airwaves from his cornfield bunker, promising rationed miracles between static bursts.
stages.epilogue: Rex now syndicates his bunker sermons as an after-market emergency broadcast kit. Subscribers receive pre-signed waiver forms, a bag of communion jerky, and coordinates for pop-up baptisms hovering over the interstate.

stages.title: Miracle Revivalist
stages.summary: Tent revivals now levitate above FEMA staging grounds while Rex barters weather reports for canned goods.
stages.epilogue: The revival caravan has annexed three municipal parking decks, each outfitted with helium hymnals and a barter window for contraband ponchos. Rex issues handwritten visas to anyone willing to chant his numerology over shortwave.

stages.title: Airborne Border Preacher
stages.summary: Rex patrols state lines in a jury-rigged blimp, notarizing miracles from 400 feet up.
stages.epilogue: His zeppelin-cathedral now sells turbulence insurance and branded parachutes. Customs officers report that Rex stamps passports with glow-in-the-dark verses warning of the next chronology breach.

stages.title: Reflection Liaison
stages.summary: Smitherson hosts voluntary erasure briefings wherever reflective surfaces gather.
stages.epilogue: He leases an abandoned mall solely for mirror calibration. Citizens queue to sign non-disclosure agreements that shimmer with ink only visible under sodium lamps.

stages.title: Historic Dampener
stages.summary: Tour groups now whisper NDA oaths into velvet-lined listening booths.
stages.epilogue: Smitherson retrofitted Philadelphia's visitor center into a library of confiscated Polaroids. Rent a booth, confess your sightings, leave with an approved replacement memory.

stages.title: Quiet Booth Architect
stages.summary: National parks sprouted mindfulness kiosks that recycle secrets into ambient whale song.
stages.epilogue: The kiosks now double as confessionals. Pay in unmarked commemorative quarters, whisper your anomaly, and Smitherson issues a meditation cassette promising plausible deniability.

stages.title: Storm Courier
stages.summary: He still treats hurricanes like postal routes and insists they tip for express service.
stages.epilogue: Neighbors report an airboat stacked with glittering mail sacks labeled 'Time Sensitive: Gator Jury Summons.' Storm shutters now come stamped with Florida Man's forwarding address.

stages.title: Great Lakes Liberator
stages.summary: Ice-surfing across the Midwest, he engraves hotline sigils into thawing freighters.
stages.epilogue: A floating garage in Lake Superior issues 'anti-freeze passports' for anyone volunteering to wax his improvised hydrofoil. Coast Guard officers keep confiscating his signature citrus-scented flares, only to find replacements already lit.

stages.title: Skywriting Ringmaster
stages.summary: County airshows now double as citrus-scented resistance briefings.
stages.epilogue: Florida Man's contrail circus now tours the Rust Belt. Ticket stubs unfold into evacuation schematics, while popcorn buckets double as Faraday cages for burner phones.

stages.title: Tabloid Mascot
stages.summary: Still photobombs every gubernatorial presser with a toothy grin and forged press badge.
stages.epilogue: Bat Boy livestreams midnight aerobics from a disused missile silo. Subscribers earn wing patches and 'bite witness' affidavits notarized by retired cryptozoologists.

stages.title: Nocturnal Ombudsman
stages.summary: He now mediates disputes between feral mascots and municipal curfews.
stages.epilogue: He maintains a hotline patched directly into sewer echoes. Callers receive scripted apologies on scented stationery, plus coupons for sonar-proof earplugs.

stages.title: Shadow Cabinet Liaison
stages.summary: Bat Boy drafts policy memos on sonar stationery for rival conspiracies.
stages.epilogue: His shadow cabinet convenes in a repurposed planetarium. Delegates swap ultraviolet dossiers while Bat Boy screens training films about polite hissing etiquette.

stages.title: Spectrum Sleuth
stages.summary: Chen still triangulates pirate broadcasts using disposable pagers and municipal Wi-Fi.
stages.epilogue: She runs a covert ham-radio quilting circle. Each stitch encodes a decryption key; every finished quilt unlocks a different satellite feed.

stages.title: Temporal Archivist
stages.summary: She now catalogs time-slipped VHS tapes before the Bureau can redact them.
stages.epilogue: Chen operates a pop-up library in a defunct video rental. Patrons check out paradox tapes with a deposit of conspiracy clippings and a promise to rewind any timeline anomalies.

stages.title: Chronicle Conductor
stages.summary: Her subway lab rewires commuter schedules to dodge governmental edits.
stages.epilogue: Rush-hour commuters now ride Chen's timetabled 'memory locals.' She issues punch cards that double as amnesia antidotes and annotates every stop with whispered warnings.

stages.title: Sideline Analyst
stages.summary: He diagrammed UFO interceptions on chalkboards outside Friday night games.
stages.epilogue: Hammond broadcasts halftime conspiracies over stadium loudspeakers. Booster clubs now fundraise for anti-abduction playbooks laminated in tinfoil.

stages.title: Bluegrass Analyst
stages.summary: He exported trick plays for dodging tractor beams to the Triple Crown circuit.
stages.epilogue: Horse barns hide his playbooks under saddle blankets. Jockeys swap coded hoof beats during warmups while Hammond referees with a whistle tuned to disrupt laser sights.

stages.title: National Counterplay Director
stages.summary: His interstate clinics now drill teams on orbital blitz drills.
stages.epilogue: He chairs a clandestine coaches congress in an abandoned scoreboard factory. Attendees trade rewound highlight reels that double as evacuation drills for impending sky scrimmages.
